brandManifest.notes: Supports visual decisions but is not locked by this visual identity checklist.

messageHouse.notes: Supports tone and positioning but is outside the active scope of this visual identity pack.

brandPrinciples.notes: Use as context for calm, literary and trustworthy visual decisions.

visualManual.notes: Use as reference until masters and export profiles are locked.

wordmark.summary: Raster logo references are available, but no vector wordmark master is locked yet.
nextActions: Select the preferred wordmark variant.
Prepare or request an SVG vector master.
Confirm light and dark usage.
wordmark.notes: Do not treat raster references as locked production masters.

logoLockup.summary: Logo lockup references exist, but primary and secondary lockups are not locked.
nextActions: Confirm the primary logo lockup.
Define clear space and minimum size rules.
Prepare SVG master.
logoLockup.notes: The lockup should not be redrawn or creatively reinterpreted during export.

symbol.summary: Symbol references are available, but no standalone vector symbol is locked.
nextActions: Confirm whether the standalone symbol is part of the official visual identity.
Prepare SVG master.
Define where the symbol can be used.
symbol.notes: The symbol can later support icons, decorative marks or watermarks only after approval.

monogram.summary: AT monogram references are available, but no monogram master is locked.
nextActions: Confirm whether the monogram is the preferred favicon/app icon basis.
Prepare SVG master.
Test legibility at small sizes.
monogram.notes: Small-size use should be validated before creating favicon and app icon exports.

colorPalette.summary: A calm dark, paper and gold direction exists, but final token roles need confirmation.
nextActions: Confirm final HEX values.
Define semantic roles for each color.
Check contrast for core text/background combinations.
colorPalette.notes: Gold should be treated as an accent, not a broad surface color.

typography.summary: Typography for headings, body text and UI has not been locked.
nextActions: Choose or document the primary typefaces.
Confirm licensing and fallback stacks.
Define basic scale and usage notes.
typography.notes: Typography decisions should support calm literary reading and practical UI clarity.

graphicMotifs.summary: Visual mood and motif references exist, but usage rules are not locked.
nextActions: Identify which motifs are official and which are only mood references.
Define acceptable use for ornaments, marks and illustrations.
Document prohibited transformations.
graphicMotifs.notes: Avoid decorative noise; the visual language should remain calm and literary.

backgroundsAndTextures.summary: Dark and paper-like visual directions exist, but background and texture rules are not locked.
nextActions: Define dark and light background roles.
Confirm whether texture assets are official.
Ensure text contrast remains readable.
backgroundsAndTextures.notes: Textures should support atmosphere without harming readability.

exportProfiles.summary: Expected export types are known, but dimensions, formats and naming rules are not locked.
nextActions: Define which exports are required for Brand Pack v1.
Specify dimensions, formats and background suitability.
Define deterministic naming rules.
exportProfiles.notes: Exports should be generated from locked masters, not directly from reference images.

brandSheet.summary: A one-page visual reference sheet has not been generated yet.
nextActions: Generate after visual identity inputs are approved and locked.
Include logo variants, symbol, monogram, palette and core usage notes.
brandSheet.notes: The brand sheet should be an output, not a substitute for locked source masters.

approval.summary: The visual identity is not ready to lock yet.
nextActions: Resolve missing visual identity blocks.
Record human approval before Brand Pack v1 lock.
Create generated exports only after approval.
approval.notes: Final lock should be explicit and versioned.
